The evidence does not define a universal tag $T^*$ for all non-representative leaves; rather, each non-representative node has its own specific tag corresponding to the transformation that maps the representative to that specific node. Furthermore, the notation $T^*$ in the evidence (Source [S1]) refers to the canonical transformation that maximizes the binary representation of the leaf itself, not the tag used in the pointer structure.
